_comment: M7a fp twin: identical architecture code path to M7 (RMSNorm, RoPE, GQA, SwiGLU, SubLN, tied head) with the 7 projections as plain fp32 nn.Linear instead of BitLinear QAT, at ~half the param count. Recipe = standard fp pretraining: AdamW (0.9, 0.95), constant wd 0.1, linear warmup -> single cosine to 0.1*peak (sched=cosine). fp arms and ternary-QAT arms legitimately get different recipes; each arm runs its own sane recipe.
_tokens: steps * batch * block = 122071 * 8 * 512 = 500,002,816 tokens (~0.93 epoch of train_8k.bin's 536,203,430)
_export: NOT engine-exportable: export_hf.py refuses fp checkpoints by design.
